adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js`, `removeMember` triggers `self.findMembers()` after deletion but does not adjust `offset`. `findMembers` computes the request offset from the *current* `this.get("user_count")` before the reload (`var offset = Math.min(this.get("user_count"), ...)`), which is stale immediately after removing a user. If you delete the last member on the last page (e.g., `user_count` was 51, `limit` 50, `offset` 50), the reload requests `offset=50` even though the new total is 50, so `GroupsController#members` returns an empty `members` array. This leaves the UI on an empty page and `currentPage/totalPages` can become inconsistent (also amplified by `totalPages` using `Math.floor(user_count/limit)+1`, which overcounts when `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit`).
